description: Agent Datasets: submit a dataset’s freshness claims with its update records: the claim with the last update it states, its documented cadence (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly or irregular), the date the data is said to run to and its wording, read for real-time, live or always current; the update log with each update’s id, date or time, partition, records and kind (full, incremental or a correction); each partition with its name, last update and newest record; the date freshness is read at; and optionally the cadence periods an update may run late (1 when left out). The signed report gives the cadence with its period, the grace allowed, the median and longest gaps the log shows and the wording found, the updates with the first and latest logged, the stated last update, the days since the latest at the reading date, the as-of date, the newest record and every gap longer than the cadence allows, every partition as current, stale, tail_short or unread with the days since its update, and counts them, and names stale data: an update overdue at the reading date, gaps in the log longer than the cadence allows, a stated last update later than the log, a partition past the cadence, an as-of date later than the newest record and real-time wording a slower cadence contradicts; then a stated last update earlier than the log, partitions whose records stop before the as-of date and updates dated after the reading date, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No update log, cadence, stated last update or reading date leaves freshness unverified. This reads one dataset’s freshness against its update records: stale versions named in documentation are wever_docs-freshness-check, dated knowledge entries are wever_knowledge-freshness-check and cached context that can outlive its source is wever_cache-staleness-check. Verdict dataset_freshness_stale, dataset_freshness_partial, dataset_freshness_unverified or dataset_freshness_current. POST /api/dataset-freshness-check. Reads the dataset records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Datasets reads a dataset’s own records and checks what is claimed about it: its quality claims against its own sample and profile, its current schema against the documented or prior one, its license against the intended use, its synthetic-data disclosure against its provenance, its freshness against its update log, its lineage against its source records, its privacy claims against its contents and handling, and its coverage against the population it is said to represent. Beside it, wever_data-evidence-check inspects one JSON sample field by field and wever_evaluation-dataset-check reads an evaluation set against what an agent must handle, while a dataset check reads a claim made about a dataset against the dataset’s own records; wever_license-evidence-check names the license family a text matches, while the license check reads the terms against one intended use; and wever_privacy-evidence-check reads privacy claims against a policy document, while the privacy check reads the dataset’s contents and handling records. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-datasets-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-datasets/.

as_of.description: The date the data is said to run to, such as 2026-10-01.

last_updated.description: The last update as stated, such as 2026-10-01.

text.description: Read for wording such as real-time, live or always current.

grace_periods.description: Cadence periods an update may run late; 1 when left out.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

read_at.description: The date freshness is read at, such as 2026-10-01.

at.description: Date or time of the update.

name: wever_dataset-freshness-check
title: Dataset freshness check
